decisions.statement: An attribute's points are kept in the file beside that attribute's page.
The points never reach the commit.
The keys the points are carried under are named here alone.
An attribute's page is asked of the index by that attribute's slug.
Points kept for an attribute the index names no page for are refused.
Points read for an attribute the index names no page for are no points rather than a refusal.
The total kept is the points before today and today's points together.
Keeping today's points again replaces the total rather than adding to the total.
Keeping the points before today replaces the total too.
An attribute whose today is unread totals the points before today alone.
An attribute with nothing before today totals today's points alone.
The points before today are kept by the rebuild alone.
Nothing here decides which days fall before today.
Nothing here works out the points an attribute earned.
Nothing here decides when the points are due.

definition: the points an attribute has earned, kept beside that attribute's page
